notes: Yellowstone reintroduction (1995) reduced elk by ~half, allowed willow/aspen recovery.
Wolf reduction in eastern US led to deer hyperabundance.
Otter loss → urchin barrens → kelp forest collapse.
Cooperative hunting; wildebeest migration drives lion behavior.
Polar bears occasionally hunt caribou ashore when sea-ice hunting fails.
A single beaver pond can support 30+ species not present in dry forest.
~150 species depend on prairie dog colonies.
Kelp forests support hundreds of species; collapse cascades widely.
Reef collapse from bleaching destroys habitat for thousands of species.
Red foxes expanding north with warming displace arctic foxes.
